druid_ghost_wolf.action_description: lunging forward with a wide claw and body sweep, then returning to the ready pose

druid_ghost_bear.action_description: raising both forepaws and slamming them heavily onto the ground, then returning to the ready pose

druid_ghost_panther.action_description: making a short forward pounce followed by a wide circular claw rake, then returning to the ready pose

druid_ghost_stag.action_description: bracing and lifting the antlers to cast a focused spirit lance forward, then returning to the ready pose

druid_ghost_lion.action_description: planting all paws and releasing a powerful spectral roar projectile forward while the mane surges, then returning to the ready pose
